# Falak Closet

> Falak Closet is a Bangladesh-based premium modest fashion e-commerce store offering handcrafted abayas, luxury hijabs, designer kaftans, borkha, and haute couture modest clothing with fast nationwide delivery (cash on delivery and bKash).

## About

- Store name: Falak Closet
- Website: https://falakcloset.com
- Country: Bangladesh
- Currency: BDT (৳)
- Categories: Abayas, Hijabs & Dupattas, Modest Dresses, Co-ord Sets, Luxury Tunics, Accessories
- Payments: Cash on Delivery (COD), bKash
- Delivery: Nationwide across Bangladesh with zone-based delivery charges (Inside Dhaka ~60৳, Outside Dhaka ~120৳, 2–5 business days)

## Key pages

- [Shop](https://falakcloset.com/shop): Full product catalog with search, category filters, and sorting
- [Product pages](https://falakcloset.com/product/): Individual products with photos, color/size variations, prices in BDT, and stock status
- [Cart](https://falakcloset.com/cart): Shopping cart
- [Checkout](https://falakcloset.com/checkout): Order placement with delivery zone selection and payment method
- [Track Order](https://falakcloset.com/track): Order tracking by order ID (FLK-XXXX) or phone number
- [Live Promotions](https://falakcloset.com/live-promotions): Active discounts, flash sales, and promo codes
- [Account](https://falakcloset.com/account): Sign in / registration, order history, wishlist, and saved addresses
- [How to Order](https://falakcloset.com/how-to-order): Step-by-step ordering guide

## Policies

- [Shipping Policy](https://falakcloset.com/shipping): Delivery zones, charges, and timelines
- [Returns & Refunds](https://falakcloset.com/returns): Return conditions and refund process
- [Privacy Policy](https://falakcloset.com/privacy): Data handling
- [Terms of Service](https://falakcloset.com/terms): Purchase terms

## Ordering

1. Browse the shop or a product page
2. Select color/size and add to cart (or use Buy Now)
3. Complete checkout with name, phone, address, delivery zone, and payment method
4. Track the order on the Track Order page using the order ID or phone number
